name: Documentation
description: Documentation App — clone, browse and edit a docs git repository added to a space.

apps.title: Documentation
apps.description: Browse and edit a documentation repository.

parameters.label: Access token
parameters.description: Secrets Store key holding the git token, as <storeId>/<key>

actions.description: Search the published markdown content of this documentation repository (the branch as pushed to its remote; drafts never match). Returns matching files with line snippets.

Read a doc by its relative path (must end with .md). Default reads the PUBLISHED version, the one readers see (the branch as pushed to its remote); a page never published has none and the read fails. Pass version "draft" for saved-but-unpublished working-tree edits. Optional offset/limit slice by 1-indexed line.

version.description: Which content to read: "published" (default) or "draft" (the unpublished draft, including what people are typing into it right now).

limit.description: Number of lines to return. Default: read to end.

actions.description: Replace an exact string in a doc. Fails if oldString is not unique unless replaceAll is true. Mirrors the behavior of the regular Edit tool.
Create or overwrite a doc. Creates parent directories as needed. Path must end with .md.
Post a reply to a comment thread anchored on a doc. Use when responding to a user comment the agent was mentioned in.

docPath.description: Relative path of the doc the comment is anchored to.

commentId.description: The id of the comment being replied to.

author.description: Author label shown in the thread. Defaults to the calling agent.

actions.description: Commit and push a single file. Other staged changes are not pulled into the commit.

path.description: Relative path of the file to commit.

actions.description: Pull the latest changes from the remote (rebase).
